weekly.title: Private weekly drive efficiency
weekly.description: Off by default. Review sustained consumption changes on comparable drives without a push or driver ranking.
weekly.vehicle: Select a vehicle to set up a private weekly review.
weekly.signIn: Sign in to set up a private weekly review.
weekly.offline: Reconnect to view or change the weekly review.
weekly.off: Off. No drive history is checked for this digest.
weekly.paused: Paused. No weekly comparison will be prepared.
weekly.ready: Active. A private weekly comparison is ready.
weekly.quiet: Active. No qualifying weekly change is ready.
weekly.clear: Turn off and clear weekly review
weekly.consent: Compare this vehicle’s recorded routes, temperatures, speeds and pack energy locally for my private weekly digest.
weekly.clearDetail: Stop weekly checks and remove this private review? The original drives and telemetry will be kept.
weekly.coverage: {{recent}} observed days last week, compared with {{baseline}} earlier days. Review uses the saved time zone, not the page date range.
weekly.why: Why this? Recorded routes, outside temperatures and average trip speeds were similar. Measured pack consumption changed in both parts of the week. This is not a diagnosis or a driver score.
weekly.parkToReview: Park and wait for fresh vehicle data to review or edit the digest. You can still pause or clear it.

routeEfficiency.title: Route efficiency
routeEfficiency.subtitle: Compare efficiency across your most-driven routes

aiSuggestions.title: Route-efficiency suggestions
aiSuggestions.description: Get a short plain-language suggestion for lower-consumption habits and route choices grounded in your own historical route data — the dominant route, its kWh/100mi figure, a comparison across your other routes, and one or two concrete, non-mutating ideas you can try yourself.
aiSuggestions.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to generate route-efficiency suggestions.

routeEfficiency.selectVehicle: Select a vehicle to see route efficiency
routeEfficiency.comparisonAria: Per-route best, average, and worst efficiency comparison bar chart

brief.description: All returned routes contribute to these totals; average consumption remains the unweighted mean of route averages.
brief.provenance: Returned route-efficiency aggregate before pagination; completeness is not declared by the source.
